page.layout: One text column, full width. Margin notes in the left margin: one beside line 4 of the first paragraph ("Daniel.8."), and a longer note block beside the second half of the last paragraph. Catchword at the right below the last line. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.p: cunt Antichristi tempore, de ultima est persecutione intelligendum: quę tunc erit, cùm belua illa Germaniā, Bohemiam, atq; alia imperia sibi nuper erepta, per secundum hanc bestiam, Societatem nostram, aliqua ex parte recuperauerit: multaq; alia regna per eandē sibi adiecta Daniel.8.viderit. Tunc enim diuitiis aucta magnificabit cor suum, & contra Principem Principum consurget, & sine manu conteretur.

Coadiutores spirituales (quo nomine omnes Sacerdotes, Theologiæ ac Philosophiæ Professores, & artium inferiorū Præceptores non professi coprehenduntur) nuncupatis prius pau-pertatis, castitatis & obedientiæ votis, bestiam hanc adiuuant in peruertendis & traducendis ad primam belluam animabus: qua in re quò quisque aptior & diligentior extiterit, eò citius ad professionem admissus membrum huius monstri efficitur.
Coadiutores vero temporales corpus huius bestiæ curant, victum atq; amictum ei præparantes, omniaq; negotia domestica tractantes.
Scholastici deniq; & Nouitii in eum finē domi aluntur, ne monstrū hoc tandē deficiat aliquādo: sed ut putrefcētibus [?] veteribus membris, in recentioribus semper & nouis conseruetur.

Porrò autem ad perpetuò occultandā, conseruandam & augendam superstitionem & i-In epist. Pet. I-gnatii de Loyo-la, qua [?] singulis [?] mensibus legi-tur ad mensam.dololatriam bestia hæc catulis suis intellectum (si quem habet) ipsumq; sensum ligat: dū monet & mandat sēriò, ut ea, quæ Superior iubet,

page.notes: Printed text in the first paragraph and the margin notes is fairly clear. Doubtful readings: "putrefcētibus" (long s and final letters unclear, marked [?]); "qua" and "singulis" in the left margin note block (the note is small and partly blurred; the hyphenated line breaks "I-gnatii", "Loyo-la", "legi-tur" are as printed). The catchword "cæcâ" stands alone at the right below the last line, so it is given only as catchword. A stray mark at the lower right (a backslash-like stroke) is not text and is left out. Long s has been normalised to s; u/v and i/j were adjusted to vowel/consonant use; "vltima" became "ultima", "vt" became "ut", "fecundum" became "secundum".
